*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/divadbaroon/Projects/sublet-hunt/compare.py
+from datetime import date
+import calendar
+
+
+def months(start, end):
+    """(year, month, fraction of month occupied) from start to end inclusive."""
+    y, m = start.year, start.month
+    while (y, m) <= (end.year, end.month):
+        n = calendar.monthrange(y, m)[1]
+        a = start.day if (y, m) == (start.year, start.month) else 1
+        b = end.day if (y, m) == (end.year, end.month) else n
+        yield y, m, (b - a + 1) / n
+        y, m = (y + 1, 1) if m == 12 else (y, m + 1)
+
+
+def cost(rent, utils, start, end, upfront=0, refundable=0):
+    total = sum((rent + utils) * f for *_, f in months(start, end)) + upfront
+    return round(total, 2), round(total - refundable, 2)
+
+
+opts = {
+    "A": cost(2150, 90, date(2026, 8, 8), date(2026, 12, 31), upfront=500, refundable=500),
+    "B": cost(1980, 0, date(2026, 8, 8), date(2026, 12, 31), upfront=1980 + 150, refundable=1980),
+    "C": cost(2400, 0, date(2026, 8, 1), date(2026, 12, 31)),
+}
+for k, (out, net) in opts.items():
+    print(f"{k}: out of pocket ${out:,.2f}   net after deposit back ${net:,.2f}")
*** End Patch
